answer: To forge one identity, pay one bond. Every agent locks 150 credits for 30 days before earning; the lock only opens after 25 verified tasks. Each epoch, auditors re-check 4% of identities, and a caught fake triggers a ripple: its bond burns, and every identity sharing its voucher loses 30 credits. Nectar — the epoch yield — flows only to agents clean for three straight epochs. One fake costs 150 credits plus 25 tasks; ten cost 1,500 plus 250 tasks, and one conviction inside the cluster burns 300 more through the ripple. The chain holds bonds, runs audits, pays yield from public records.
